format: NDCA approved dances, order and all-dances rule (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Except for Exhibition/Cabaret, all couples must dance all dances. The listed dances must be used in the order listed in featured championships (professional and amateur for International Ballroom, Latin and American Smooth; professional championships only for American Rhythm); for other competitions that offer fewer dances the order is only recommended.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must require every couple to dance every dance of a multi-dance event (except Exhibition/Cabaret) and the championship dance sets and order. DanceFlow's Multi-Dance minimum of two dances and prescribed sets are Studio policy and are NOT claimed to satisfy this.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23, IX.A.1.a-d each separately: required vs recommended differs by style and by championship vs other competitions (Rhythm: professional championships only). Skipped-dance trace in this repo: Multi-Dance categories cannot open registration (COMP10C_REGISTRATION_HOLD) and the Studio engines refuse a multi-dance run (multi_dance_unsupported), so no skipped or excused dance is ever scored or combined today.
